description: The file defines a React component for the homepage of a web application. It manages UI state for search and create overlays, handles user interactions, and integrates various child components such as ConnectorSelector, SearchOverlay, CreateOverlay, and Chat. It also fetches connector data using an API call and sets up hotkeys for user interactions.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the homepage, manages state, handles events, and composes child components.
